entries.zh: 指；指点、指给人看（以手指示教）
entries.en: to point at; to teach by pointing out
entries.notes: M 栏残损（'aunnādo chýūn'难辨）且 M 声调 T99，据 L/H/R 推定为'指'之指点义

entries.zh: 法；讲法、传授教义（天主教教理语境）
entries.en: doctrine, the (religious) law; to teach (Christian) doctrine
entries.notes: R 栏声调 T99 污损，据 L/H/M 定'法'讲法传教义

entries.zh: 教训；教导并训诫、教而正之
entries.en: to teach and instruct; to admonish, correct

entries.zh: 教诲；谆谆教诲、开导
entries.en: to instruct, edify (formal teaching)

entries.zh: 教示；教导、指点
entries.en: to teach, show; to give instruction
entries.notes: M 第二字声调 T99，据 L/H/R 定'教示'教导义

entries.zh: 导谕；引导训谕、开导规正
entries.en: to guide and instruct; to admonish, correct

entries.zh: 规矩；规矩法度，教导规矩（教理之规）
entries.en: rules, norms; to teach the rules (of the doctrine)
entries.notes: M 第三声调 T99 且尾符'st'难辨，据 L/H/R 定规矩教导义

entries.zh: 家教；家中尊长所施之教导
entries.en: the teaching of the (household) superior; family instruction

entries.zh: 指引；指引方向（指明道理缘由）
entries.en: to guide, point the way; to point out the reason

entries.zh: 道明；阐明道理（以慈爱教导，传教用语）
entries.en: to make the Way/doctrine clear; to teach with charity

entries.zh: 指示；指示、指点以示之
entries.en: to point out, indicate; to instruct by pointing
entries.notes: 第二字声调 M/R 均为 T99 污损，据字面'指示'与 L 定指点义

entries.zh: 训谕；训诲告诫、晓谕
entries.en: to instruct, admonish; to enjoin

entries.zh: 传下手；传授于下手（教导后学、徒弟）
entries.en: to teach the junior (apprentice, the less advanced); to pass on the teaching

entries.zh: 婉谕；婉言相劝、温言教导
entries.en: to instruct with gentle words; to admonish mildly

entries.zh: 传后世；传于后世、传给子孙后代
entries.en: to teach the descendants; to hand down to posterity
entries.notes: L 栏残损（'cendiente'应为 descendiente 后代）且声调 T99，据 H/M/R 定'传后世'传于后代义

entries.zh: 师传／师傅；师傅私下传授（从师受教）
entries.en: private teaching by the master; master-to-disciple instruction
entries.notes: H 第二字 [疑:傅/傳]，L 'ca'似 casa 缩写，据 M/R 定师传私授义

entries.zh: 监；监禁、囚押（监管关押）
entries.en: to confine, enclose; to keep in custody
entries.notes: L 栏残损、M 第二成分仅存'ca.'且声调 T99，据 H 定'监'监禁/监管义

entries.zh: 监禁；监禁、关押
entries.en: to imprison, confine
entries.notes: L 栏残损；H/M/R 三栏互证'监禁'囚禁义

entries.zh: 含；含纳、包含（兼口中含物之义）
entries.en: to contain, hold within; to hold in the mouth

entries.zh: 包含；包含、涵容（含深奥之义）
entries.en: to contain, encompass; to hold great (sacred) mysteries within
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:包/色] 且 R 首音 pàn 与'包'对音稍异，据 M 'páu' 与 L 定包含义
